veil.name: VEIL
veil.note: Clean, powdered, the smell of skin after the shower
veil.line: Skin, ten minutes after the shower.
veil.story: Clean skin, powder, a little warmth. VEIL is you, ten minutes after the shower. It does not carry across a room. It stays within arm's length, which is where musk is meant to sit.
veil.who: The one to start with. Clean, powdered, close to the skin. It also works as a base: a perfume sprayed over it holds longer.
veil.wear: On its own for work. Under another musk when you want more. Under your perfume when you want it to stay. Reapply whenever, it never stings.

mirage.name: MIRAGE
mirage.note: Oud, softened by vanilla, over white musk
mirage.story: Oud first, dark and dry. Then the vanilla comes in and rounds it off. Not sweet, not smoky. Within the hour it settles warm and woody, close to the skin, and stays there.
mirage.who: For evenings, dinners and cold days. For anyone who loves oud but wants it softer.
mirage.wear: Two points on the neck are enough. Over VEIL if you want the oud quieter. Under a woody perfume to hold it past midnight.

ember.name: EMBER
ember.story: Black cherry and almond over amber. The musk underneath keeps it from turning sweet. It opens bright, then softens and warms as the hours pass.
ember.who: For evenings out. Warm and fruity, held down by the musk so it never turns loud.
ember.wear: Wrists and the inside of the elbows, where you run warmest. A little goes far. Over VEIL if you want the cherry rounder.

halo.name: HALO
halo.note: Pistachio and caramel over white musk
halo.story: Pistachio first, then a warm caramel that wraps around it. The white musk underneath keeps it soft, so it reads as warmth, not dessert.
halo.who: For the hours that belong to you. At home, a slow day, winter, the sofa, the car.
halo.wear: Behind the ears and behind the knees, where the warmth lasts longest. On its own when you are staying in. Over VEIL when you want it softer.

house.h: A house that makes musk, and nothing else.
house.short: A house that sells forty things sells musk as one of them. We make one thing. We answer for it.
house.p1: Musk has been worn here for generations. After the shower. In the bag. Again in the afternoon. Given at Eid. The gesture needed nothing from us.
house.p2: What it never had was a house behind it. The same white musk is sold under fifty names. The perfume brands treat it as one line out of forty.
house.p3: So we kept the gesture and rebuilt everything around it. Four musks composed in France. A gel in a soft tube that goes everywhere with you. One object, finished properly.
house.fine: Every tube arrives in its own case. Ready to give as it is.

words.p: Everything a musk house says, in plain language. Nothing here is marketing vocabulary.

1.p: The base of everything we make. Warm, skin-like, and the reason a scent stays close to you instead of announcing itself from the door.

2.p: The clean, powdered kind. It reads like skin ten minutes after a shower. VEIL is built on it, and the other three sit over it.

3.p: Resinous wood, dark and dry. A few drops change the direction of a whole formula. In MIRAGE, the vanilla rounds it off.

4.p: Warm, resinous, faintly sweet. It weighs a scent down so it carries into the evening. The floor under EMBER.

5.p: A material that slows down everything laid over it. Musk is one. Put it on first and the perfume you spray on top holds for hours longer.

6.p: How far a scent travels away from you. Ours stays within arm’s length, and that is a choice, not a limit.

7.p: Two scents, one over the other. The second lands on the first instead of replacing it. Four musks make six pairs.

8.p: Where the blood runs close to the skin and the warmth releases the scent. Wrists, the sides of the neck, behind the ears, the collarbone, inner elbows, behind the knees.

9.p: A spray lifts off the skin in the first minutes and takes the scent with it. A gel sinks in and releases slowly, for six to eight hours.

10.p: A scent built on notes you could eat: vanilla, caramel, pistachio. Held down by musk, it reads as warmth, not dessert. HALO is one.

11.p: The three stages of a scent. The top is the first ten minutes, the heart is the hour after, the base is what is still on your scarf at midnight.

12.p: Several materials blended to read as one smell. A cheap accord is bought ready-made by the barrel. Ours are built from materials that each have a name.

1.h: I have never used musk. Where do I start?
1.p: VEIL, the white musk. Clean, powdered, close to the skin. The easiest to wear. Want all four? The coffret costs less than four singles.

2.h: Can I wear it for prayer?
2.p: Yes. It is a gel, with no alcohol in it. You can also top it up at any hour on warm skin without it stinging.

3.p: No. Composed in France, with no deer musk and no alcohol.

4.h: Will it survive the heat here?
4.p: Better than a spray. A spray lifts off in the first minutes. A gel sinks in and stays where the skin is warm. Six to eight hours, longer on fabric.

5.h: Will it mark my clothes or my abaya?
5.p: On skin, not fabric. Give the gel thirty seconds to sink in, and keep it off silk. Wrists, neck, behind the ears, behind the knees.

6.h: How long does one tube last?
6.p: Two to three months, used once a day. Keep it out of direct sun.

7.h: How do delivery and payment work?
7.p: 1 to 3 working days, tracked. Free over 250 AED, 29 AED below. Card, Tabby, Tamara, or cash at the door.

8.h: How is this different from the musk sold here?
8.p: The base is the one you know, worn the same way. What changes is what sits over it: oud and vanilla, black cherry and amber, pistachio and caramel, composed in France. And a soft tube you carry everywhere, instead of a glass bottle.

9.p: Yes, unopened, in its case, within fourteen days of delivery.
